gloss: to show, to reveal, to express

definitions.explanation: To make something visible or known.

notes:
あらわす has multiple kanji, each with distinct meanings but the same reading.

WRITING:
- {現|あらわ}す: to reveal, to make visible (⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{現|あらわ}す - to appear)
- ⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express, represent (⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧ - express feelings)
- ⟦{著|あらわ}す→著す：02279_arawasu⟧: to write/publish a book (⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{著|あらわ}す→著す：02279_arawasu⟧)
